notes:
Summary:
- Vertical: legacy media house + distributed digitized AV archives (news, long-form documentary transcripts, captioned video). Heavy long-doc content: many multi-hour transcripts + OCR'ed images.
- Dataset size: ~1.1M assets, ~18M transcript pages, avg doc length 25k-120k tokens, target POC subset 10k assets (~220M tokens).
- Primary need: high-quality RAG search — embeddings + hybrid BM25 + cross-encoder reranker for top-K precision on long queries. Must handle long-context matches (scene-level) and time-stamped hits.
Key technical constraints / asks:
- Chunking strategy discussion: prefer semantic segmentation by scene/dialogue with variable chunk size (512-2048 tokens), 20% overlap for continuity; consider two-tier index: coarse 2048-token coarse chunks for retrieval, fine-grained 512-token chunks for reranker candidates. Want guidance on deduping/overlap effects on recall/cost.
- Indexing scale & infra: planning initial index for 10k assets; full production index ~1.1M assets -> need shard estimate, storage cost, and reindexing window (prefer rolling ingest). Concern about indexing throughput and warm-up time.
- Embedding model preferences: higher-dim (1536-2048) for better semantic fidelity on long docs; evaluate quantized embeddings (8-bit) for storage savings. Need Redwood Optimize recommendations for model + quantization tradeoffs.
- Reranker tuning: using a bi-encoder candidate set (top-200) + cross-encoder reranker. Trade-offs: increasing candidate set improves recall but raises cross-encoder cost. POC target: top-10 precision > 0.85 on editorial queries. Need guidance on candidate size vs latency/cost.
- Latency/throughput targets: target P99 end-to-end query latency <= 800ms for 50qps burst; cost target <$0.04 per query at 10k qpm monthly equivalent (looking for batching/caching levers). Must show fallbacks to cheaper model variant under load.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching, result caching for repeated editorial queries, TTL strategy. Also interested in vector cache for hot segments (top 1% of queries).
- Routing: want to route high-priority customers to dedicated pool, fallback to hosted-compatible model. Need policy examples.
- Security/compliance: EU residency required for EU customers; SSO/SAML + audit logs and KMS.
POC history / timeline:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE Jordan + SE Alex) — discussed dataset and outcomes.
- 2026-01-25: Sent ingest checklist + sample transcode scripts (Drive: ingest-scripts.zip).

- 2026-02-18: SE tuning session — tested chunk size sweep (512 / 1024 / 2048) and overlap; saw recall lift but cross-encoder latency impact. Notes: 1024+20% overlap best balance for editorial tasks.
- 2026-02-25: Security review questionnaire submitted to legal (drive link).
- 2026-03-01: Internal cost estimate from Sonic infra team — projected monthly reranker cost unknown (requested Redwood cost model).
Open questions & action items:
- Redwood action: provide model-choice + quantization recommendation (Optimize) for Sonic POC (due 2026-03-07).
- Redwood action: sample shard plan and storage estimate for 1.1M assets; propose dedicated pool sizing for 50qps p99 target.
